End-to-end half of D1B. The signature half landed (bd-01M2TAC80YRK5JFNKTT7B7CAQN): typed SourceView, TypedSupport/PlaybackSupport, exact intervals. Carrying non-text support in mapping records belongs to G1/G2 (hsmm/v4 intentionally refuses non-text support); the full film model wire is V1 (bd-01M1CQQDCWN2RTT1Z8XNNB7VMY).
Acceptance, using a StoryModel produced by NarrativeCompiler.compileFilm (bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P) through its general AlignmentSource:
1. One film source unit with two interval alternatives receives exact posterior mass on each; fixed-seed P and F are deterministic; one hand-computable case matches an independent numerical oracle.
2. Blend, compression, omission, backward revisit, reorder, long jump, typed external excursion and distortion remain distinguishable.
3. Refusals: row-absent keys, explicit zero-flow foreign endpoints, non-finite likelihood, mismatched flow marginals; substitution of provider/geometry/source/recall/edition/axis/candidate/cost receipt. Channel removal is not provider abstention or Unranked.
4. All text WorkedExample outcomes and S0 pins unchanged; the displayed-mass remainder is retained.
Gate: reference-scope; align+laws JVM/JS/Native; SD2 checkAll with bound totals; named compiled mutations; SD6 cold review. No codec/renderer/provider/calibration change.
